description:
Approve a client to submit feedback up to a specified index limit. Must be called by the agent owner. Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

agentId.description: Agent ID to approve a client for

client.description: Stacks address of the client (SP... mainnet or ST... testnet)

fee.description: Fee preset ("low", "medium", "high") or micro-STX amount. Optional.

indexLimit.description: Maximum feedback index the client is approved for

sponsored.description: Use sponsored transaction relay so a relay service pays fees instead of your wallet. Requires SPONSOR_API_KEY env var or wallet-level sponsorApiKey.

name: reputation_approve_client
